title: Prepare and execute the Heim-PC NixOS vNext migration
goal: Turn the canonical Heim-PC NixOS 26.05 executor architecture into a reversible production migration without weakening truth, recovery, hardware acceptance or closure-bound activation contracts.
completion: Declared facts, runtime facts and hardware acceptance are implemented as separate source-bound evidence surfaces and the archived physical Gate A/B evidence is consumed without being mistaken for current live truth.

Managed Nix/NixOS implementation outputs and the independently implemented storage-rehearsal component patch are integrated through ancestry-preserving local Git merges, handed between pre-publication stages through content-addressed immutable artifacts, then prepared as one separately leased protected Heim-PC pull request by T008, exclusively merged by T009 through a Captain merge-commit path preserving T001/T002/T005/T006/T007 ancestry, and finally sealed by T010 from the exact terminal T009 merge-commit tree into the immutable published-source artifact. T011 then re-builds and seals the exact final storage-target closure identity from that artifact through an explicitly approved Build effect in exclusive disposable build isolation, without any Activation effect; T003 must bind that exact T011 closure/build receipt, prove its disposable GPT/LUKS/Btrfs topology, and only then perform the final-source activation/live-readback/rollback proof.

Automated Nix/NixOS builds and activations use a managed, receipt-bound path that binds the exact source artifact, system closure, target and effect class and fails closed before unauthorized host mutation. The final-source Build/closure identity is proved by T011 with a Build receipt; only after T003 has proved its disposable storage topology and prior/recovery runtime may T003 derive a separate target-bound Activation receipt and perform the first activation of that exact final closure.

The exact production storage target topology GPT + EFI + recovery surface + LUKS2 + Btrfs with @root, @nix, @persist, @home, @data and @containers is reconstructed from a blank virtual disk, booted, unlocked and restore-tested before production storage mutation.
All migration-relevant non-reproducible data are classified and covered by an independently restorable off-host backup; current green scoped backups are not treated as full-cutover recovery evidence.
An independent bootable recovery path plus offline host/control reconstruction material is verified without Grabowski, Bureau, network or the production system SSD.

Only after the preceding gates pass may a separately reviewed one-disk cutover plan bind the exact production device and authorize destructive storage effects; post-boot readback must prove the running closure equals the approved closure.

metadata.migration_boundary: This initiative does not itself authorize partitioning, mkfs, LUKS mutation, EFI/Secure-Boot key changes, firmware writes, reboot or NixOS switch on the production host. T008 may prepare only the final protected source PR, T009 may change only protected repository source truth through the exact Captain merge, T010 may create only the immutable post-merge published-source artifact, T011 may realize only the managed Build effect needed to seal the final closure identity inside exclusive disposable build isolation and may not perform any Activation/storage effect, and T003 may perform destructive/runtime effects only inside its separately authorized disposable storage-rehearsal sandbox using a separately reviewed target-bound Activation receipt. Productive destructive/runtime effects remain separately reviewed and recovery-gated.
